title: D-Link IP Camera Unauthenticated Configuration & Credential Disclosure
description: An issue was discovered in D-Link DCS-series IP camera firmware through 1.14.04. An unauthenticated attacker can query /common/info.cgi to obtain administrative passwords and network configuration in plaintext.
remediation: Update camera firmware to version 1.14.05 or higher. Isolate camera to a dedicated restricted VLAN and change default management passwords.

title: Hikvision IP Camera Unauthenticated Remote Command Execution
description: A command injection vulnerability in the web server of Hikvision cameras allows attackers to gain full administrative root access via specially crafted message packages sent to the device without authentication.
remediation: Apply the official Hikvision security firmware update (v5.5.800 or newer) and enforce network access control lists.

title: Dahua IP Camera and DVR Hardcoded Backdoor Credentials
description: Multiple Dahua DVR and IP Camera models contain hardcoded cryptographic credentials and hidden administrative accounts (e.g. 7ujMko0vizxv) accessible via Telnet or web interfaces.
remediation: Update Dahua firmware to remove the backdoor accounts and disable Telnet access.

title: Xiongmai / Sofia IP Camera & DVR Remote Code Execution & RTSP Bypass
description: Multiple Xiongmai-based IP cameras and DVRs allow unauthenticated remote attackers to bypass RTSP stream authentication and execute arbitrary commands via undocumented JSON APIs on port 80/554.
remediation: Disable cloud P2P features, block incoming traffic on ports 23, 80, 554 from untrusted networks, and apply vendor firmware patches.

title: TBK & H.264 DVR Authentication Bypass & Credential Harvesting
description: An authentication bypass vulnerability in multiple DVR devices allows remote attackers to obtain user credentials by crafting a Cookie: uid=admin HTTP header sent to /device.rsp.
remediation: Replace legacy DVR hardware or place behind a secure VPN gateway with zero direct network exposure.
